# cortex_relationship_type (Resource)

Relationship Type resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cortex_relationship_type" "example" {
  tag                   = "service-to-database"
  name                  = "Service to Database"
  description           = "Tracks which services depend on which databases."
  allow_cycles          = false
  is_single_source      = false
  is_single_destination = false
  definition_location   = "SOURCE"

  sources_filter = {
    include = true
    types   = ["service"]
  }

  destinations_filter = {
    include = true
    types   = ["resource"]
  }

  source_label_singular = "Service"
  source_label_plural   = "Services"

  inheritances = [
    {
      parameter_tag    = "x-cortex-owners"
      inheritance_type = "FALLBACK"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allow_cycles` (Boolean) Whether cycles are allowed in this relationship type.
- `definition_location` (String) Where the relationship is defined (e.g. SOURCE or DESTINATION).
- `destinations_filter` (Attributes) Filter for which entity types can be destinations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destinations_filter))
- `is_single_destination` (Boolean) Whether each source can only have one destination.
- `is_single_source` (Boolean) Whether each destination can only have one source.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the relationship type.
- `sources_filter` (Attributes) Filter for which entity types can be sources. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sources_filter))
- `tag` (String) Unique identifier (tag) for the relationship type.

### Optional

- `create_catalog` (Boolean) Whether to generate a catalog page for this relationship type.
- `description` (String) Description of the relationship type.
- `destination_label_plural` (String) Plural label for the destination entity.
- `destination_label_singular` (String) Singular label for the destination entity.
- `inheritances` (Attributes Set) Parameter inheritance configurations for this relationship type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inheritances))
- `source_label_plural` (String) Plural label for the source entity.
- `source_label_singular` (String) Singular label for the source entity.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_cortex_managed` (Boolean) Whether this relationship type is managed by Cortex.
